Agent Name: WebSurfer
Step Number: 12
Reason for Mistake: The WebSurfer obtained the wrong dataset by clicking “Domestic” on the worldwide page, producing a domestically sorted worldwide chart instead of the official 2020 Domestic Year list from Box Office Mojo. This miscollected data directly skewed the overlap comparison and led to the incorrect final count. While later steps finalized the error, this was the root data mistake that caused the wrong result.
